challenge.name: The Inconsistent Checks
challenge.description: #data_dave# insists on keeping the quality checks manually done to control costs. #reliability_ruth# argues for full automation to ensure consistent results.

output.content: The manual quality checks are a bottleneck for the deployment pipeline. I need those checks automated so we can run them on every single commit without waiting for a human to sit down and click through the forms. The more frequent and consistent those checks are, the better our signal becomes for catching drift before it hits production. I am asking for full automation of the validation steps. If we can add more checks to the automated suite, that is strictly better for the system. I want the pipeline to be fast and thorough, with no human dependency in the critical path.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that adding more checks is strictly better and desires maximum frequency and consistency, indicating that exceeding the basic request for automation would increase their satisfaction.
